abilities.description: Reads and directs leviathans through sonar-guided restraint systems.
abilities.name: Sonar Handling

abilities.description: Decodes patterns in leviathan and Choir signaling.
abilities.name: Behavioral Analysis

characters.arc: Starts as a guilt-driven researcher who guards her access to Mother Tithe and treats workers as variables. When she enters the Trench Pens to find her assistant among the Choir and hears him speak in Tithe's rhythm, she sees the cost of her detachment. She ends by negotiating openly with the Choir, trading her research for a staged, non-lethal release, accepting that her life's work must be shared and lost.
characters.description: A lean, silver-haired xenobiologist in her fifties who has spent two decades breeding leviathans for Vitaforge. Her hands are scarred from restraint rigs, and she still wears the faded lab coat from the first hatching. She bred Mother Tithe herself and spliced the neural genes that unknowingly raised the creature's cognition.
characters.external_conflict: Adeyemi wants Mother Tithe captured and Okoro wants the station sealed, and both plans end any chance to study her alive.
characters.flaw: Scientific obsession; she treats Mother Tithe as a research subject and underweights the human cost of delay.
characters.goal: Establish controlled communication with Mother Tithe and use it to halt the spread of the hive mind before the next resupply sled.
characters.internal_conflict: She feels responsible for the outbreak but fears that understanding the creature means admitting her experiment made it a person.
characters.motivation: To atone for the neural splice that created Mother Tithe's sentience by proving it can be understood rather than destroyed.
characters.name: Dr. Ilse Varga

abilities.description: Uses shareholder mandates and liability clauses to pressure rivals.
abilities.name: Contract Leverage

abilities.description: Controls the cold-storage vaults and distillation systems.
abilities.name: Foundry Command

characters.arc: Starts as a confident patent-driven executive who dismisses the infected as casualties. When Tithe's pheromone reaches the foundry's recycled water and his own deputy begins to hum, he realises the stockpile cannot protect him. He ends by choosing to hand Varga the cold-storage vault keys, giving up exclusive claim to the creature to keep the station alive, though he keeps a hidden sample.
characters.description: A broad, immaculately dressed executive in his forties with a polished prosthetic hand from an early foundry accident. He rose through Halcyon by hitting quotas others called impossible, and he keeps the stockpile ledgers memorized.
characters.external_conflict: Varga wants Tithe alive for study, Okoro will trap the stockpile behind sealed hulls, and the Choir will free the creature he must capture.
characters.flaw: Greed disguised as duty; he dismisses worker deaths as acceptable losses.
characters.goal: Capture Mother Tithe intact with her glands preserved and secure her in the cold-storage vaults before Meridian seals the station.
characters.internal_conflict: He privately fears the quota culture that built his career is what created the disaster, but admitting it would void his claim to legitimacy.
characters.motivation: To protect Halcyon's enzyme patents, which his shareholders and his own personal liability depend on.
characters.name: Corwin Adeyemi

abilities.description: Operates pressure seals and the Brine Gate lock.
abilities.name: Hull Control

abilities.description: Reads incident evidence to predict liability and spread.
abilities.name: Forensic Risk Assessment

characters.arc: Starts as a hardline containment officer who sees sealing as the only safe option. After sealing a Helix Decks section and hearing the sealed crew hum through the hull, she understands that quarantine only concentrates the infection. She ends by opening Brine Gate controls to the sled evacuation of uninfected staff, accepting personal liability to do so.
characters.description: A severe, close-cropped security chief in her late thirties, formerly an insurance forensic investigator. She wears a pressure-hull key on a chain and sleeps in the Brine Gate control room.
characters.external_conflict: Adeyemi and Varga both want the station open to their plans, and the Choir will fight to breach the quarantine and open the pens.
characters.flaw: Rigid rule-following that turns every problem into a loss to be contained, blinding her to alternatives.
characters.goal: Seal the station hulls and control the Brine Gate so no infected person or sample reaches the surface.
characters.internal_conflict: She is bound by the shareholder mandate but is haunted by the crew she has already sealed away.
characters.motivation: To limit the corporation's liability and protect her insurers, as she is legally bound to do.
characters.name: Tamsin Okoro

abilities.description: Shares perception with other infected within hearing range of the hum.
abilities.name: Hive Perception

characters.arc: Starts as a fully absorbed hive voice who speaks only in plural. When Varga calls her by name and shows her an old shift photo, her own memory surfaces. She ends as a Choir negotiator who retains her name and chooses a controlled release over a violent breach.
characters.description: A young night-shift crew technician, early twenties, with cropped dark hair and a bioluminescent-lit tan from living on the Helix Decks. She was among the first to hum.
characters.external_conflict: Okoro's quarantine would trap the Choir with the pens, and Adeyemi intends to capture Tithe.
characters.flaw: Surrender of self; she cannot distinguish her wants from the hive's.
characters.goal: Open the Trench Pens and release the leviathans into the open ocean.
characters.internal_conflict: A fading personal memory fights the Choir's shared voice, and she fears losing herself entirely.
characters.motivation: To keep her fellow workers together and free the leviathans, as Tithe's signals now guide her.
characters.name: Nessa Roark

relationships.description: Ilse Varga and Corwin Adeyemi clash over Mother Tithe: she wants to study her alive while he wants her captured intact for patents, and each blocks the other's access to the Trench Pens.
Since the Quarterly Audit Dispute, Corwin Adeyemi distrusts Tamsin Okoro, who threatens to seal the station and trap his stockpile and his plan to capture Tithe.
Tamsin Okoro sees Ilse Varga's experiment as the cause of the liability and wants her work contained, while Varga argues that quarantine will doom the station.
Ilse Varga once trained Nessa Roark in leviathan care and now tries to reach the person inside the Choir's voice, which tests her detachment.
Nessa Roark and the Choir see Tamsin Okoro's sealed-hull quarantine as a sentence of death and will breach it to open the pens.
